units.source_scale_reason: Fixed scale per original master preserves approximately 193px human anatomy plus the approximately 230px total canopy-to-sole silhouette of the existing 256px reference. No per-pose height normalization: crouched and fallen poses retain source standing scale. Anatomical foot/body contacts anchor independently from nozzle/hose extents.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed original sources and ordered native Windows Godot phases at actual128px reference height:56 distinct paintings across8 actions, readable nozzle-hand idle, corrected reciprocal near/far gait, two-handed melee shove, aim/mist release/recovery, dedicated recoil/held guard, physical empty-hand support and continuous grounded collapse with tipped backpack and tethered sprayer. Original leaf/bark greaves restored after rejecting copied ivory armor; clipped idle and ambiguous near-walk drafts excluded. Fixed anatomical scale per source, planted-foot/body registration, no synthetic articulation or within-clip repeats. Final candidate132 checks pass for timing/normal/fast/reduced motion and unchanged simulation/save state. Continuous playback, Linux and manual playtest are not claimed.
